lines.t: A house of glass and I was shattering there
I'd sit by the river, let the current take the sound
Of a girl who was lost waiting to be found
I drank the poison just to kill the sting
Chasing the ghosts of every hollow thing
And then He gave me you, my treasure, my life
The answer to the prayers I cried in the night
I promised the water, I promised the sky
I'd never let the world see the tears in your eyes
I'd be your armor, I'd be your shield
I remember the storm, the scales fell away
I covered your eyes, I couldn't let you stay
I ran for the exit, I ran for the door
I couldn't breathe that poison anymore
But now you're a mirror reflecting the past
Walking the shadows that I used to cast
I'm standing outside watching you leave
Tracing the patterns I used to weave
And letting you, darling, don't go where I've been
Don't let the cold water pull you back in
But I can't follow
I found my home
I'm finally settled
I'm finally known
He is my love
He is my love
I'm staying with him
Through the dark and the light
I've made my choice
I'm staying
I'm staying
